hunt.name: Rogue ScreenConnect Scripted Persistence and Evasion
hunt.description: This hunt identifies the post-infection lifecycle of a phishing campaign that abuses Microsoft Power BI. It follows a phased approach: first, it identifies hosts with rogue ScreenConnect activity and correlates it with known RMM relay domains and deployment scripts; second, it pivots to find secondary scripted persistence via rare scheduled tasks and the execution of the HideUL evasion tool. By weighing early-stage execution against follow-on persistence and evasion, the hunt identifies active intrusions that simple RMM-based alerts might miss.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_cmd_line, user_name, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%screenconnect%' OR LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%screenconnect%') AND LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%temp%' AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify hosts running ScreenConnect components or installers specifically from temporary directories to focus the hunt.
config.expected_signal: A list of hosts with ScreenConnect activity in temp paths. Silence is expected in clean environments.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, query_hostname, process_name, time FROM hb_dns_activity WHERE instr(',' || '{{c2_domains}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(query_hostname) || ',') > 0 AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')

config.expected_signal: DNS resolutions for reported rogue infrastructure from hosts showing suspicious RMM activity.

config.content: SELECT job_name, job_cmd_line, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS hosts, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_scheduled_job WHERE (LOWER(job_name) = LOWER('{{persistence_task_name}}') OR LOWER(job_cmd_line) LIKE '%scautofix.ps1%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY job_name, job_cmd_line HAVING hosts < 3
config.description: Identify rare scheduled tasks that execute the deployment scripts on systems that showed rogue RMM activity.
config.expected_signal: A rare scheduled task appearing on scoped hosts referencing the rogue scripts.
